# Parano1d v0.1.0: Mainnet

**Public network launch · 12 August 2026**

Parano1d v0.1.0 starts the public network from its mainnet genesis. It is the
first production release of the Parano1d node and wallet.

Parano1d is a proof-native Layer 1 ordered by proof of work. Its live State
carries a recursive proof of the valid path from genesis through the current
transition. A joining full node can authenticate the present State without
replaying the network's lifetime transaction execution.

The complete validity path from genesis is covered by an executable end-to-end
post-quantum soundness theorem at the NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography Category 1
resource threshold.

## Packages

Choose the GUI package for the Parano1d wallet, its built-in full node and
mining from the desktop application. It does not require a separate daemon or
terminal.

Core archives are intended for headless node operation, command-line use and
external mining. They contain the full node, command-line wallet client and
external miner.

Native packages are attached for Linux x86-64, Linux ARM64, Windows x86-64,
macOS Apple Silicon and macOS Intel.
